page.layout: One text column, with the running head above it. No notes in the margins. Below the column a line "lunt" completes the last word.

main_text.l: 6 وایل Wayel, Hamyari filius ita Abulfeda, at alii
Hamyaro fratrem ipsius Cahlanum successisse volunt: &
pro Wayel, habent واثل Wathel.
7 السكسك Alsacsac, Wayeli filius. AlJaubari
السكاسك Alsacasec filium Wayela
vocat.
8 جعفر Yaafar, Alsacsaci filius.
9 ذو رياش Dhu Riyash, cui nomen عامر est posteris Alsi filii Hamyar.
10 النعمان AlNeoman, Yaafari filius, المعافر Al-
Moafer dictus, qui collectis copiis Amcrum fugavit.
11 اسمح Asmah Neomani filius.
12 شداد Shaddad filius Adi, f. AlMatata, f. Saba,
qui ad ultimum usque occidentem pertingens multa
potentiae suae vestigia reliquit.
13 لقمان Lokman, Shaddadi frater[at Allamnabius
post Shaddadum collocat مرثد Morthedum, qui ذو
اود Dhu Aud, cognominatus, (quem sexcentos
annos regnasse refert AlFiranzabadius) deinde عمرو
Amrum Morthedi filium.
14 ذو سدد Dhu Sadad ejusdem fater.
15 الحارث AlHareth, Dhu Sadadi filius, qui الحرث الرايش AlHareth alRayesh, quod reportatis in
Yamanum [poliis populum ditavit, cognominatus est.
quoniam راش الناس فى ايامه [Because in his dayes
they feathered their nests, ut loquuntur nostrates,] ā
ريش quod proprie plumam per metaphoram opes
denotat. Hic ille est cui تبع الاول i.c. Tobbaa
16 ذو القرنين Dhu'l Karnain Affaab,
Rayeshi filius: atque hunc Bicornem istum, cujus in
Alcorano mentio, non Alexandrum Macedonem esse vo-
lunt.

page.notes: Page 58 of the book. Entry 16 runs over into the next page: the word "volunt" is split as "vo-" / "lunt" at the foot of the column; the second part is written in full here. Arabic and Hebrew are transcribed as printed; Arabic forms and vowel marks were hard to read on the scan (see the Arabic in entries 7, 9, 10, 13, 15), so these may contain errors. Printed spellings are kept, including "fater" in entry 14 and "reportatis". The brackets in "[poliis" and "frater[at" are as printed. The Google digitisation stamp at the foot is left out.
